content.study:
Topic at a glance
CURRENT-LAW UPGRADE — The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 is in force from 21 November 2025. For current disputes, replace the historical IDA ss. 22–24 framework with IR Code ss. 62–64: notice/prohibition rules, illegality, and prohibition on financial aid to illegal strikes or lock-outs. Distinguish statutory illegality from protected/regulated industrial action and test the timing of notice, conciliation, Tribunal/arbitration proceedings, and operative settlements or awards.

IDA ss. 22–24 — Prohibition of strikes and lock-outs (IDA ss. 22-24) is a registered section in Labour & Industrial Law. cases.name: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa
cases.facts: The Constitution Bench considered the meaning of industry under the Industrial Disputes Act.
cases.issue: What functional test determines whether an undertaking is an industry?
cases.ratioDecidendi: The triple test examines systematic activity, cooperation between employer and employee, and production or distribution of goods or services, subject to recognised exclusions.
cases.holding: The Court adopted a broad functional interpretation.
cases.relevance: Use for IDA s. 2(j) and coverage.

cases.name: State Bank of India v. N. Sundara Money
cases.facts: The Court examined termination and the statutory meaning of retrenchment.
cases.issue: Whether termination falling outside the employer's stated reason may amount to retrenchment.
cases.ratioDecidendi: Retrenchment receives a broad meaning subject to the statutory exceptions and conditions precedent.
cases.holding: The Court applied the protective scheme to the termination in question.
cases.relevance: Use for IDA s. 2(oo) and s. 25F analysis.

cases.name: Workmen of Meenakshi Mills Ltd. v. Meenakshi Mills Ltd.
cases.facts: The Court considered the constitutional and statutory safeguards governing retrenchment.
cases.issue: How should retrenchment controls be reconciled with management and economic interests?
cases.ratioDecidendi: Retrenchment safeguards are conditions precedent and must be complied with according to the protective statutory scheme.
cases.holding: The Court upheld scrutiny of statutory compliance.
cases.relevance: Use for retrenchment and industrial adjudication.
